# MD4C

Dice!Next vendors MD4C 0.5.3 from the official release-0.5.3 tag:

- Source: https://github.com/mity/md4c
- Files: md4c.c and md4c.h
- License: MIT; see LICENSE.md in this directory.

The library is compiled as a static C99 target and is used only for structural
Markdown parsing when a reply must be downgraded to plain text.
